ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import buildSignals from dwl::trend_signals output application/java --- buildSignals(vars.evalResponse.dimension_trends, vars.window.value)

logger.doc:name: LLM Generation Failed
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, error: error.errorType, description: error.description } --- buildLog("INFO","LLM generation failed, falling back to template",message,vars.correlationId, "create-llm-based-text")]

logger.doc:name: Custom Model Generation Failed
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, error: error.errorType, description: error.description } --- buildLog("INFO","Custom Model Generation Failed, falling back to template",message,vars.correlationId, "create-custom-based-text")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import addText from dwl::trend_text --- addText(vars.trendConclusions,vars.evalResponse.dimension_trends, vars.window.value)

%dw 2.0 output application/json fun returnMetric(dimension) = vars.evalResponse.dimension_trends[dimension] fun returnMacrosMetric(nutrient) = vars.evalResponse.dimension_trends.macros[nutrient] fun returnMicroMetric(nutrient) = (vars.evalResponse.dimension_trends.micronutrients filter ((item) -> item.nutrient == nutrient))[0] var days = vars.window.value as Number var start = vars.window.start as Date var end = start + ("P$(days - 1)D" as Period) --- { generationType: "trend_analysis", correlationId: vars.correlationId, evaluation: { window_days: days, window_start: start, window_end: end, conclusions: vars.trendConclusions map ((item) -> (item - "condition_context") ++ { metric: if ( item.dimension == "micronutrients" ) returnMicroMetric(item.nutrient) else if ( item.dimension == "macros" ) returnMacrosMetric(item.nutrient) else returnMetric(item.dimension) }) } }

logger.doc:name: Prompt Created
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, prompt: vars.llmPrompt } --- buildLog("DEBUG","Prompt Created",message,vars.correlationId, "orchestrate-trend-analyis-subflow")]

logger.doc:name: LLM Request Complete
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, status: vars.llmResponse.statusCode } --- buildLog("INFO","LLM Request Complete",message,vars.correlationId, "create-llm-based-text")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import attachLlmText from dwl::parseLLMText var body = read(vars.llmResponse.body, "application/json") --- attachLlmText(vars.trendConclusions,body)

logger.doc:name: LLM Text Attached
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId } --- buildLog("INFO","LLM Text Attached",message,vars.correlationId, "create-llm-based-text")]
